auftrag: Read the newspaper report. Then solve four puzzles.

saetze: Yesterday, Agent Wren found the Silver Compass in a café in Brighton.
It was wrapped in a green cloth.
Only Wren and a trainee knew about the cloth.
But Mr Hale talked about it.
Pidge the pigeon flew to the police, and at six o'clock they arrested him.

raetsel.frage: What is the best summary of the report?
optionen: Sam opened a new café in Brighton.
A double agent was caught because he knew too much.
A pigeon won a race in London.
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the whole report. What is the big news?
raetsel.hilfe2: Look at the sentence with "double agent".

raetsel.frage: Tap the sentence that shows how Mr Hale gave himself away.
raetsel.hilfe1: Look for the word "cloth". Who talked about it?
raetsel.hilfe2: It comes right after the sentence about Wren and the trainee.

raetsel.frage: Put the events in the right order. What happened first?
items: Mr Hale talked about the cloth.
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the report from top to bottom.
raetsel.hilfe2: Pidge flew to the police before the arrest.

raetsel.frage: Put the words in the right order. It is a sentence from the report.
raetsel.hilfe1: The sentence starts with the time.
raetsel.hilfe2: After "the police" comes the word that tells you what they did.
